about: Locator.X announced-project record: corporate and public project announcements near the corridor areas. An announcement is an intention with a date and a source — never a forecast of delivered capital or jobs. Every row carries `status` (announced only / under construction / cancelled), `jobsBasis` naming whose figure the headcount is and whether anything was independently confirmed, and `url` to the announcement. Source edition: usnew5 (window.LXCORP).
extracted: Extracted 2026-09-11 from the live published Locator.X editions listed in docs/PUBLISH_MAP.md, by fetching each artifact and decompressing the packed payload the edition ships. Nothing was re-keyed, recomputed or filled in: each row is the edition's own record, and a field the edition leaves absent stays absent here. Re-extract rather than edit.

projects.project: Richland Parish / Hyperion AI data centre campus - ~10M sq ft, 5 GW IT capacity
